title: Brady's money throwing on Saturday nights
summary: Morris explains how Senator Brady threw silver money to the crowd on Saturday nights.

story.theme_name: Getting paid: wages, tips and leaving over money
story.community_name: Getting paid: wages, scale and the pay envelope

blocks.x: Oh we were talking about Senator Brady
And then uh...what did you say? You had the Razu?

Oh yeah, you had the Razu Oh that was the best senator they ever had in the state I believe He had everything out there and he'd come on Saturday night with one sack of money in each hand Silver money you know, that's to make everybody Razu for their money I used to get on off the stand and go Razu too for their money What does Razu mean? Throw up money you know, till you done emptied the sack No I am Throw the jails up in there on the floor And you know people used to come for that Gee whiz, they all would be packing jam and you had to grab for that money Yes sir, that's what he used to do
